law.catch_line: Prohibited acts by mixed beverage licensees; penalty

text.section: Any person convicted of a violation of this section is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

The provisions of subdivisions A 12 and A 13 shall not apply to persons operating theaters, concert halls, art centers, museums, or similar establishments that are devoted primarily to the arts or theatrical performances, when the performances that are presented are expressing matters of serious literary, artistic, scientific, or political value.
